Recovery configuration/control

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x6c
Size:
0x4
Source:
usb_ocp_recovery_reg.rdl

Description

RECOVERY_CTRL bytes 0-2 plus one pad byte. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 RECOVERY_CTRL. Firmware accesses the fields through cpuif; USB Recovery Agent writes use the hardware interface. Recovery FSM actions are qualified by the USB hardware write path, not by the firmware cpuif write.

Contents

Bits Identifier Access Reset Decoded Name
[31:24] RESERVED_31_24 r 0x0 Reserved
[23:16] ACTIVATE_REC_IMG rw 0x0 Activate Recovery Image
[15:8] REC_IMG_SEL rw 0x0 Recovery Image Selection
[7:0] CMS rw 0x0 Component Memory Space

Field Descriptions

RESERVED_31_24 - Reserved

Byte 3 is padding introduced by the DWORD-aligned RDL view and is not part of the OCP command payload.

ACTIVATE_REC_IMG - Activate Recovery Image

Byte 2 requests activation of the selected recovery image. The USB Recovery Agent writes 0x0F through the hardware interface; firmware can clear the stored request through cpuif after device handling. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 RECOVERY_CTRL.

REC_IMG_SEL - Recovery Image Selection

Byte 1 selects memory-window or device-stored recovery image source. USB Recovery Agent writes use the hardware interface. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 RECOVERY_CTRL.

CMS - Component Memory Space

Byte 0 selects the component memory space containing the recovery image. USB Recovery Agent writes use the hardware interface. OCP Recovery v1.1 Sec 9.2 RECOVERY_CTRL.
